acceptance_criteria.given: a task with a costed run, evidence, an approval that merged, a divergence and an override
acceptance_criteria.then: every kind is present oldest first, the run carries model, duration and cost, and the summary counts them

acceptance_criteria.given: a story in the route's order
acceptance_criteria.then: events appear in exactly that order
the drawer opens on Story, a proof shows the wording and the diff, Details keeps the facts, reduced motion shows every event, no console error

acceptance_criteria.given: a scratch Hub and a Haiku agent
acceptance_criteria.then: the run and its evidence appear in the open story without a reload, marked fresh

design: D1 One route, one order. The UI renders the route's order and never sorts, so a test of the route's order covers the screen. D2 Story is offered only while it can load: a Hub before /story (the operator's :8000 until restarted, while the committed bundle already reaches it) answers 404 and the drawer stays on Details. D3 Acceptance quiet, rejection loud: an accepted review is a line, a rejected one a callout. D4 Judged on a replica of Terra through Vite's dev server, so nothing touches the bundle :8000 serves until the slice is committed.

limits: The acceptance drives were written alongside the build, not before it

problem: The visibility map of 2026-10-17 found a task's history spread across six screens or none: transitions without their override reasons, runs without cost, evidence only in a collapsed spec bar without its reviews, divergences behind an unused hook, check runs only as the newest. F672/F673: the operator could not find or judge evidence. Slice task-story of roadmap spdoc-d882f76795b3; shared parts are slice foundations (motion and state tokens, Timeline, StatePill, Expander, DiffView, the Playwright judge on a Terra replica, vis-D6/vis-D8).

requirements.statement: GET /tasks/{id}/story MUST return the task, a summary (runs, cost, tokens, evidence counts, merged commits, override count) and every transition, run, evidence piece with its reviews, check run, integration, divergence and question bound to the task, sorted by time with ties ordered cause before effect, and 404 for an unknown task.

requirements.rationale: The operator's question is whether the task is done and how it got there.
requirements.statement: The task drawer MUST open on the story when it can be loaded, rendering events in the route's order, and MUST fall back to the details view without offering a switch when it cannot.

Each evidence event MUST show its state, its reviews with their reasons, and whether a later piece replaced it, and MUST open into the requirement's wording beside the command, output and coverage, with the diff of the work fetched only when opened.

requirements.rationale: An approval over failing checks was recorded and never shown.
requirements.statement: A transition approved over failing checks MUST show its override reason.
An open story MUST add events from task, evidence and run events without a reload, marking each arrival for one highlight.
Every animation of the story MUST be absent under prefers-reduced-motion, with every event visible in the first rendered frame.

in_scope: GET /tasks/{id}/story: transitions, runs with model, duration and cost, evidence with wording, output and reviews, checks, merges, divergences, questions, oldest first, with a summary
The drawer's Story view (default) and Details view; Story offered only while the story can load
Live refresh on task, evidence and run events, an arrival glowing once
Shared parts and story styles, every animation off under reduced motion
non_goals: Any change to what a transition, run or review records

summary: The task drawer opens on a timeline of everything that happened to the task, under a summary answering whether it is done, with each piece of evidence opening into its proof.
